thread:
Sophia - AE: FYI — Emerald Solutions asked for a custom price on Premium Add-ons. They want 25% off + Net45. Invoice INV-2026-0198 is queued. Can finance + legal sign off? Deal is a 12mo pilot with potential Dedicated migration.

Matt R (Finance): Can you paste expected commitment / ARR and contract length? 25% is high.

Sophia - AE: 12-month pilot, $20k/mo list for the add-on = $240k ARR. Expected usage ~120M tokens/mo across 2 apps. Upside into Dedicated in Q3 if pilot succeeds.

Matt R (Finance): Rough margin impact calc — if we give 25% => effective monthly rev = $15k -> contribution margin dips below our threshold unless we move them to a higher-latency / lower-cost quantized profile. Elaine, thoughts?

Elaine (Finance Manager): Need a quick P&L. For discounts >20% I need gross margin >= 40% after hosting & infra. Also finance prefers Net30 for new customers; Net45 needs exec approval or structured milestone payments.

Jordan (Legal): Do we have SOC2 + DPAs in place? Net45 increases AR risk. Suggest conditional approval: Net45 only after credit check + signed SOW with milestone invoice schedule.

Sophia - AE: They can provide SOC2 + 2 supplier refs. Sales is pushing Net45 because of their procurement cycle. Would a $15k onboarding credit + 18% discount be acceptable instead of 25%?

Matt R (Finance): $15k one-time credit + 18% recurring discount looks more acceptable. Run the math vs term length; if they commit 12 months that softens the hit. Also prefer discount applied to product only, not to usage overages.

Riya (Sales Ops): Logged as DEAL-7892 in the pipeline. If finance signs off on 18% + $15k credit and Net30, I can push contract for signature this week. Here's the clause I propose:

```payment_terms: 30 days; onboarding_credit: $15,000 applied to invoice 1; discount: 18% for 12 months; conditional Net45 only with approved credit check and documented milestone invoices```

fin-bot: Deal recorded: DEAL-7892 | Owner: Sophia | Stage: Contracting | Linked INV-2026-0198

Elaine (Finance Manager): Approve 18% recurring discount + $15k onboarding credit. Require Net30 standard. If customer provides validated credit check and signs by 2026-04-05, allow Net45 in writing. Also require data-export and escrow clause for pilot data. Send final SOW to Legal for redline.

Sophia - AE: Awesome — I'll update contract and ping Legal. Thanks team :tada:

Jordan (Legal): I'll review SOW tonight. If SOC2 and refs check out, can clear the Net45 addendum. cc @Riya.
